chunks: Whatever was in it from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam.

key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: may Allah be pleased with him; an honorific supplication for the narrator’s father
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct authorial reporting of the chain
key_terms.عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ: from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam; the named transmitter whose route is being clarified

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam in the book. It documents the author’s route of transmission through his father, Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, and Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, serving as a hadith-sciences notice rather than a doctrinal or legal matn.
